When I requested back-up I didn't dream the Senate would send a ''Jedi Knight''.''"<br />"''Your report explained that your forces have met with ''strong resistance'', Commander.''"<br />"''That's an understatement!|The clone commander and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="tfa" />}}
A '''clone trooper commander''' served on a [[Gyndine moon|moon]] of the [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] [[Gyndine system/Legends|system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point during a [[Battle of the Gyndine moon|battle]] on the surface, he sent a message to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] requesting assistance with their situation of overwhelming [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces on the planet. The Senate responded by sending [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to Gyndine to aid the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]].<ref name="tfa" />
